Title: Approved flow boundary
Test Case Description: [Stage 1 target] Prove approval prerequisites drive lifecycle completion and is_approved, while status is display-only
Pre-Conditions:
1. Core placement fields are complete
2. Every active requirement is verified
3. At least one report is non-deleted and valid
4. Descriptions may be absent because they are optional narrative
5. Student and authorized coordinator fixtures exist
Test Steps:
1. Submit the complete placement for coordinator review
2. Attempt approval as the student
3. Approve as the authorized coordinator
4. Inspect is_approved and completion behavior
5. Change/read the free-string status and verify it does not authorize or complete the placement
6. Request the approved filtered view and PDF projection
Expected Result:
1. [Stage 1 target] Student submission reaches coordinator review
2. Student approval is denied
3. Authorized coordinator approval succeeds because all three prerequisites are satisfied
4. Approval sets/reflects is_approved and drives completion
5. Approval succeeds with no description present
6. Free-string status does not drive authorization or completion
7. Filtered view and PDF provide safe, traceable output

3. Attempt approval with no non-deleted valid report
4. Attempt approval with all three prerequisites complete but no description
5. Set/read a free-string status during each variant
Expected Result:
1. [Stage 1 target] Missing core placement fields block approval and leave is_approved incomplete
2. Any unverified active requirement blocks approval and completion
3. No non-deleted valid report blocks approval and completion
4. Approval is allowed and completion derives from is_approved when all three prerequisites are complete, regardless of description presence
5. Free-string status does not authorize, block, or complete the placement
